notes.title: UPDATE DEMO - Deadly Laser Card, Card Auras, and In-depth Threat Level
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160415/2a170c75263970abf461d05a67fa6de48aee332e.png"][/img]   [/p][h1]This is the commander speaking! [/h1][p][/p][p]With the Six One Indie Game Showcase just around the corner, we are excited to release an updated demo of Mini Tank Mayhem. This update introduces a range of new features and improvements, including a powerful new card the death ray from the sky...TLDR !! [/p][p]This update also includes enhanced visuals, refined gameplay settings, and various balance adjustments. Players can now experience Threat Level 3, and enjoy the addition of rarity-based card auras. These changes aim to provide a more engaging, polished, and enjoyable demo experience as we celebrate Six One Indie Game festival.[/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog:[/h2][h3][b]General[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Added new card: [b]TL;DR[/b] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added card aura based on rarity [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added
